cases.name: a guard whose script is missing blocks the call: PreToolUse, exit 2, one line naming the hook
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; r=$(run pre gone); case $r in 'rc=2 out= err=hook-run: the guard hook gone could not be read ('*'missing or unreadable) - the call is blocked'*) printf ok ;; *) printf 'BAD:%s' "$r" ;; esac

cases.name: a guard bash cannot read (a folder in its place: exit 126) blocks the call
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; mkdir "$D/own/odd.sh"; r=$(run pre odd); case $r in 'rc=2 out= err='*) printf 'ok:%s' "$(grep -c '^hook-run: the guard hook odd could not be read (.*exit 126)' "$D/err")" ;; *) printf 'BAD:%s' "$r" ;; esac

cases.name: a guard script left unreadable by its mode blocks the call (root reads every mode: the folder case covers it then)
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/locked.sh" 'exit 0'; chmod 000 "$D/own/locked.sh"; if [ -r "$D/own/locked.sh" ]; then printf 'ok'; else r=$(run pre locked); case $r in 'rc=2 out= err=hook-run: the guard hook locked could not be read'*) printf ok ;; *) printf 'BAD:%s' "$r" ;; esac; fi; chmod 644 "$D/own/locked.sh"

cases.name: exit 127 of a guard is mapped to 2 on UserPromptSubmit; never on SubagentStop, where exit 2 would send the subagent back to work for as long as the check stays unreadable
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/nf.sh" 'exit 127'; a=$(run ups nf); b=$(run sub nf); printf '%s|%s' "${a%% err=*}" "${b%% err=*}"

cases.name: the same failures on SessionStart keep their code: not blocked, no hook-run line
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; mkdir "$D/own/odd.sh"; a=$(run ses gone); b=$(run ses odd); printf '%s|%s|%s' "${a%% *}" "${b%% *}" "$(grep -c hook-run: "$D/err")"

cases.name: a guard that exits 0, 1 or 2 keeps its code, and its stdout comes back as written
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/g.sh" 'printf "{\"x\":%s}" "$X"; exit "$X"'; for x in 0 1 2; do r=$(run pre g X=$x); printf '[%s]' "${r%% err=*}"; done

cases.name: stderr of the hook passes untouched and adds no hook-run line when the hook ran
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/w.sh" 'echo warned >&2; exit 3'; r=$(run pre w); printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR set: the hook is run from there, not from the launcher's folder
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/where.sh" 'printf own'; probe "$D/stage/where.sh" 'printf stage'; r=$(run pre where HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR="$D/stage"); printf '%s' "${r%% err=*}"

cases.name: HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR set without the hook in it, or unset: the launcher's own folder
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/where.sh" 'printf own'; a=$(run pre where HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR="$D/stage"); b=$(run pre where); printf '%s|%s' "${a%% err=*}" "${b%% err=*}"

cases.name: the hook run from HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR sees its own folder there (BASH_SOURCE), so ../lib resolves in the staging copy
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/stage/here.sh" 'cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd'; r=$(run pre here HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR="$D/stage"); [ "$r" = "rc=0 out=$(cd "$D/stage" && pwd) err=" ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD:%s' "$r"

cases.name: stdin reaches the hook byte for byte: trailing newlines, UTF-8, quotes, 300 KB
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/own/cap.sh" "cat > '$D/got'"; { pre; printf '
\xc3\xa9 \" 	'; head -c 300000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' a; printf '

'; } > "$D/sent"; o=$(env -u HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR bash "$L" cap < "$D/sent"); rc=$?; cmp -s "$D/sent" "$D/got" && printf 'same rc=%s' "$rc" || printf 'DIFF rc=%s %s/%s' "$rc" "$(wc -c < "$D/sent")" "$(wc -c < "$D/got")"

cases.name: a payload without hook_event_name, or not JSON, is not a guard: the code is kept
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; a=$(printf '{}' | bash "$L" gone 2>/dev/null; printf 'rc=%s' $?); b=$(printf 'not json' | bash "$L" gone 2>/dev/null; printf 'rc=%s' $?); printf '%s|%s' "$a" "$b"

cases.name: no hook name: exit 0 and silent, exit 2 on a guard event
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; a=$(run ses ''); b=$(run pre ''); printf '%s|%s' "$a" "${b%% err=*}"

cases.name: HARNESS_HOOK_RUN=0: the plain runner of the workshop copy, HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR ignored, no mapping
cases.cmd: . {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{CLAUDE}} {{SID}}; probe "$D/proj/.claude/hooks/where.sh" 'printf proj'; probe "$D/stage/where.sh" 'printf stage'; a=$(run pre where HARNESS_HOOK_RUN=0 CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$D/proj" HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR="$D/stage"); b=$(run pre gone HARNESS_HOOK_RUN=0 CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$D/proj"); printf '%s|%s|%s' "${a%% err=*}" "${b%% *}" "$(grep -c hook-run: "$D/err")"

cases.name: settings.json: every hook goes through the launcher read from HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR, onFailure block on the guard events that honour it, the switch on by default
cases.cmd: jq -r '[([.hooks | to_entries[] | .key as $e | .value[] | .hooks[] | select(.command | startswith("bash \"${HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks}/hook-run.sh\" ") | not)] | length), ([.hooks | to_entries[] | .key as $e | .value[] | .hooks[] | select((($e == "PreToolUse" or $e == "UserPromptSubmit" or $e == "UserPromptExpansion") and .onFailure != "block") or (($e == "PreToolUse" or $e == "UserPromptSubmit" or $e == "UserPromptExpansion" | not) and has("onFailure")))] | length), .env.HARNESS_HOOK_RUN] | "off-form=\(.[0]) bad-onfailure=\(.[1]) switch=\(.[2])"' {{CLAUDE}}/settings.json

cases.name: the launcher is an executable file in LF with no accented letter
the real launcher runs a real guard of the harness, inert on its empty payload: exit 0, silent
cases.cmd: o=$(printf '{}' | env -u HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/hook-run.sh secret-guard 2>&1); printf 'rc=%s out=%s' $? "$o"

cases.name: timed through the runner: a PreToolUse payload with no hook name is refused with exit 2

expect.stderr: hook-run: the guard hook  could not be read

cases.name: frozen literal: the Dockerfile sets HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR to the staging copy of these hooks, beside its lib/ (in the image, where no Dockerfile is, these hooks are that copy)
cases.cmd: lit=/usr/local/share/claude-harness/claude/hooks; f={{ROOT}}/../Dockerfile; if [ -f "$f" ]; then e=$(grep -c "^ENV HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR=$lit\$" "$f"); c=$(grep -c '^COPY harness/ /usr/local/share/claude-harness/$' "$f"); else e=1; c=1; [ "$(cd {{CLAUDE}}/hooks && pwd -P)" = "$lit" ] || e="image:$(cd {{CLAUDE}}/hooks && pwd -P)"; fi; printf 'env=%s copy=%s lib=%s launcher=%s settings=%s' "$e" "$c" "$([ -f {{CLAUDE}}/lib/team-common.sh ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" "$([ -f {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/hook-run.sh ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" "$(( $(grep -c 'HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR:-' {{CLAUDE}}/settings.json) == $(jq '[.hooks[][].hooks[]] | length' {{CLAUDE}}/settings.json) ))"
